steps.content: After a fierce battle, Lynn is almost out of energy. Yet the voice of OwO the Archdemon is still beyond reach.

steps.speaker: Villager
steps.content: Don't mind us! Go find the candy... You can't defeat her now! You have to keep safe!
The voices of the villagers echoed weakly from the cave.
Lynn gives up on trying to enter the cave and continues to look for the candy of courage.
